subject: Romag
fact: Romag woke the party after eight hours of rest with urgent news.
source_quote: Romag woke the party after eight hours of rest with urgent news.

subject: Lieutenant Krell
fact: Lieutenant Krell had fled to the gnoll and bugbear territories, plotting rebellion against the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Lieutenant Krell had fled to the gnoll and bugbear territories, plotting rebellion against the Earth Temple.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: Earth Temple forces would guard the entrance and exit while the party approached from behind through the dangerous gnoll-infested area.
source_quote: Earth Temple forces would guard the entrance and exit while the party approached from behind through the dangerous gnoll-infested area.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag was known for micromanaging and lacking the cleverness of his predecessor, who had been promoted to the deep temple.
source_quote: Romag was known for micromanaging and lacking the cleverness of his predecessor, who had been promoted to the deep temple.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple's strategy relied on overwhelming enemies with masses of low-level troops rather than the powerful monsters employed by the Fire, Water, and Air Temples.
source_quote: The Earth Temple's strategy relied on overwhelming enemies with masses of low-level troops rather than the powerful monsters employed by the Fire, Water, and Air Temples.

subject: Krell
fact: Krell's voice encouraged the gnolls, revealing his betrayal: 'I told you they would try to kill you. The Fire Temple protects its own.'
source_quote: Krell's voice encouraged the gnolls, revealing his betrayal: 'I told you they would try to kill you. The Fire Temple protects its own.'

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer cast powerful magic that summoned spectral guardians to devastate the clustered enemies.
source_quote: Calmer cast powerful magic that summoned spectral guardians to devastate the clustered enemies.

subject: hand crossbow contraption
fact: Krell wielded a peculiar hand crossbow contraption—a pistol of his own devising.
source_quote: Krell wielded a peculiar hand crossbow contraption—a pistol of his own devising.

subject: Sequioa
fact: Sequioa quickly revived Calmer with a healing potion, and the grateful cleric thanked him for his loyalty.
source_quote: Sequioa quickly revived Calmer with a healing potion, and the grateful cleric thanked him for his loyalty.

subject: Alremm
fact: Alremm, under the Fire Temple, valued power and glory, offering to join forces to destroy the Earth Temple and be hailed as heroes.
source_quote: Alremm, under the Fire Temple, valued power and glory, offering to join forces to destroy the Earth Temple and be hailed as heroes.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag demanded Krell be brought back alive.
source_quote: Romag demanded Krell be brought back alive.

subject: brazier
fact: Platinum pieces were hidden in a brazier.
source_quote: Platinum pieces were hidden in a brazier.

subject: three-dragon ante set
fact: A three-dragon ante set was discovered among the treasure.
source_quote: A three-dragon ante set was discovered among the treasure.

subject: ornate corridors
fact: The party was led through ornate corridors of polished brown marble veined with black and inlaid with yellow triangular patterns, lit by burning bronze crescents.
source_quote: The party was led through ornate corridors of polished brown marble veined with black and inlaid with yellow triangular patterns, lit by burning bronze crescents.

subject: ritual chamber
fact: The ritual chamber had rough-hewn sandstone walls and a floor of dark brown earth, dimly illuminated by phosphorescent lichen.
source_quote: The ritual chamber had rough-hewn sandstone walls and a floor of dark brown earth, dimly illuminated by phosphorescent lichen.

subject: twenty-foot pyramid of hard-packed dirt
fact: At the center stood a twenty-foot pyramid of hard-packed dirt topped with a stone column bearing carved triangles and bronze knives.
source_quote: At the center stood a twenty-foot pyramid of hard-packed dirt topped with a stone column bearing carved triangles and bronze knives.

subject: earth elementals
fact: Four massive earth elementals rose from the ground at Romag's command and slowly approached the altar.
source_quote: Four massive earth elementals rose from the ground at Romag's command and slowly approached the altar.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch suggested they could use their new allies—the party—as weapons against the Fire or Air Temple.
source_quote: Hartsch suggested they could use their new allies—the party—as weapons against the Fire or Air Temple.

subject: charred library
fact: The charred library contained the burned remains of books on evil philosophy, double-dealing, self-advancement, and treachery.
source_quote: The charred library contained the burned remains of books on evil philosophy, double-dealing, self-advancement, and treachery.

subject: sacred earth triangle
fact: References to the sacred earth triangle were found among the remnants.
source_quote: References to the sacred earth triangle were found among the remnants.

subject: Commander Joradin
fact: Commander Joradin asserted his authority over that section of the temple and ordered them to return to their quarters.
source_quote: Commander Joradin asserted his authority over that section of the temple and ordered them to return to their quarters.

subject: Dick Rentsch
fact: Joradin was a new recruit brought in by Dick Rentsch who didn't yet understand how things worked in the temple.
source_quote: Joradin was a new recruit brought in by Dick Rentsch who didn't yet understand how things worked in the temple.

subject: territory cleared of gnolls and bugbears
fact: Romag granted them the territory they had cleared of gnolls and bugbears as their own base within the Earth Temple.
source_quote: Romag granted them the territory they had cleared of gnolls and bugbears as their own base within the Earth Temple.

subject: written permission
fact: Romag provided them with written permission to explore freely.
source_quote: Romag provided them with written permission to explore freely.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag warned them sternly not to betray his trust.
source_quote: Romag warned them sternly not to betray his trust.

subject: Earth Temple territory
fact: The Earth Temple's territory extended throughout specific areas of the complex, and the party now controlled a significant portion of it.
source_quote: The Earth Temple's territory extended throughout specific areas of the complex, and the party now controlled a significant portion of it.

subject: Krell
fact: Krell screamed about being tricked as Romag shoved dirt into his mouth.
source_quote: Krell screamed about being tricked as Romag shoved dirt into his mouth.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag declared that everyone must witness the consequences of betrayal and ordered the party to attend a ritual sacrifice in the great chamber.
source_quote: Romag declared that everyone must witness the consequences of betrayal and ordered the party to attend a ritual sacrifice in the great chamber.
